messages:
sam: FYI I opened PR #4321 — adds a 'latency vs cost' pivot example for Console telemetry and a tiny trace header example for SDKs. Need quick look from anyone on traces + a sanity check on the screenshot path.

jules: Thanks — linking. Can you paste the trace header name you used? I want to make sure it matches the tracehook examples.

sam: Sure it's `X-RDWD-TRACE-ID` (upper-case), added note that it can be `traceparent` too.

marty: Minor nit: in the Go snippet you reference `TraceMiddleware` but our SDK uses `TraceHandler` now. Might be stale.

sam: ah good catch. I copied older sample. I'll update to `TraceHandler` and keep a commented line that maps old name.

ingrid: The pivot table screenshot path in the PR points to `docs-assets/latency-pivot.png` — that file isn't in the PR. Can someone add it or point to the hosted image?

sam: I can add the png to the assets folder in a follow-up. For this PR I'll switch to the hosted URL so CI can render the preview.

jules: While you're here, can you add a short note about how batching affects the cost column? A one-line caveat under the example.

sam: Will do. Proposed line: "Note: request batching and KV cache hits reduce per-token cost, so table values are illustrative for unbatched traffic." OK?

ingrid: LGTM. Also add a test snippet for Python that shows injecting the header:```python
from redwood import Tracing
client = Tracing().wrap(client)
client.headers["X-RDWD-TRACE-ID"] = trace_id
```

marty: For Go:```go
// use TraceHandler shim to attach trace id
handler := sdk.TraceHandler(func(r *Request) string { return r.Header.Get("X-RDWD-TRACE-ID") })
```

docs-bot: link-checker: running checks on PR #4321... (this may take a minute)

sam: I also renamed the dashboard YAML keys to use `latency_ms` instead of `p95_ms` to be more general for the pivot widget. Wanted to call that out in case anyone pinned to the old key.

jules: Good change. Might be worth adding a short compatibility note under the YAML block: how to map `p95_ms` -> `latency_ms` for existing embeds.

sam: added mapping snippet in the PR description. Also added a small migration checklist in the docs page with steps: 1) update metric key, 2) re-run export, 3) verify widget.

ingrid: CI flagged one broken link to SDK docs — it's missing the new `TraceHandler` page. Could we add an inter-doc placeholder link to `/sdk/go/tracing` for now?

marty: I'll create a minimal doc page under /sdk/go/tracing with the handler example and point the link there. Won't require a full writeup.

sam: Great, thanks — once Marty adds that, I'm planning to squash + merge. Any objections?

jules: no objections from me. Small ask: add a one-sentence callout for customers using Dedicated: note that hosted routing may alter observed latencies.

sam: added that line.

docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link remains -> /sdk/go/tracing (expected). Approvals: 2/2.

sam: merging after Marty drops the placeholder doc. I'll ping when merged. :tada:

marty: placeholder pushed at /sdk/go/tracing, added the TraceHandler example. Should unblock CI.

sam: merged. Thanks! I'll follow up with the png asset PR and a small note in the changelog about the `latency_ms` key rename.
